goal: Review a pull request for scope, tests, risk, and whether a reviewer can understand and check it.
use: Review a pull request for scope, tests, risk, and whether a reviewer can understand and check it. Use when a pull request is ready for review.

steps.note: Read the description. Check that the description says what changed, why, and how it was tested.
Check scope. Flag unrelated edits, and a change that mixes a refactor with a behaviour change.
Check tests. Each behaviour change needs a test.
Check risk. Note what could break: data, public interfaces, configuration and deployment order.
Check the size. Flag changes too large to review in one sitting, and say how they could be split.
Report. List the findings in order of risk, each with file and line.

protocol.title: Read the description
protocol.text: Check that the description says what changed, why, and how it was tested.

protocol.title: Check scope
protocol.text: Flag unrelated edits, and a change that mixes a refactor with a behaviour change.

protocol.title: Check tests
protocol.text: Each behaviour change needs a test. Flag changes that only touch tests, or tests that were deleted.

protocol.title: Check risk
protocol.text: Note what could break: data, public interfaces, configuration and deployment order.

protocol.title: Check the size
protocol.text: Flag changes too large to review in one sitting, and say how they could be split.

protocol.title: Report
protocol.text: List the findings in order of risk, each with file and line. End with a verdict: ready, needs changes, or split first.
